description: Military-grade cyber-amphetamine. The label is mostly warnings.

effects.onset_message: Your heart speeds up and stays fast.

overdose.message: Your heart clenches and doesn't start again.

phases.comedown_message: It wears off. Your hands start to shake.
phases.comeup_message: Your pulse races. Everything around you seems to slow down.
peak_message: You're at the peak, and you feel like you could do anything.
Everything speeds up, and you're already moving.
Everything is loud and fast and yours.

effects.take_line: You dose {name}, the way the label tells you not to.

withdrawal.message: Your teeth won't stop grinding. You need another hit.

stages.easing: The world feels like it's speeding back up. It was never slow.
stages.peak: Your heart's racing and you've only been sitting down, which was meant to help.
stages.rising: Everything seems slow: the lift, the door, the person in front of you. It isn't, really.
stages.tail: Normal speed. It still feels slow, because you'd forgotten what normal was.

name: Redline
